title: Reefer Cargo Services: accepted set-point and fresh-air ventilation ranges by tier
content:
## Scope

This quick reference of **Reefer Cargo Services** states the carrying temperature (set point) and the fresh-air ventilation setting that each tier accepts on a reefer service order.

## Rule

1. The set point must lie between the tier's lowest and highest carrying temperature, **both limits included**.
2. A ventilation setting above 0 is accepted only when the tier allows fresh-air ventilation, and then only up to the tier's highest ventilation setting.

## Quick reference by tier

| Tier | Lowest set point | Highest set point | Fresh-air ventilation | Highest ventilation setting |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| AHL Reefer Standard | -30.0 °C | 30.0 °C | Allowed | 285 cubic metres per hour |
| AHL Reefer Monitored | -30.0 °C | 30.0 °C | Allowed | 285 cubic metres per hour |
| AHL Reefer Cold Treatment | -2.0 °C | 2.5 °C | Not allowed | 0 |
| AHL Reefer Controlled Atmosphere | -2.0 °C | 15.0 °C | Not allowed | 0 |
| AHL Reefer Pharma GDP | 2.0 °C | 25.0 °C | Not allowed | 0 |
| AHL Reefer Superfreezer | -65.0 °C | -35.0 °C | Not allowed | 0 |

Temperatures are stated in degrees Celsius to one decimal; ventilation in whole cubic metres per hour.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical requests)

| Tier | Requested set point | Judgement |
|---|---|---|
| AHL Reefer Cold Treatment | 2.5 °C | Accepted: equal to the highest limit, which is included |
| AHL Reefer Cold Treatment | 2.6 °C | Not accepted: above the highest limit |
| AHL Reefer Pharma GDP | 2.0 °C | Accepted: equal to the lowest limit |
| AHL Reefer Pharma GDP | 1.9 °C | Not accepted: below the lowest limit |
| AHL Reefer Superfreezer | -60.0 °C | Accepted: inside the range |
| AHL Reefer Superfreezer | -30.0 °C | Not accepted: warmer than the highest limit of that tier |

| Tier | Requested ventilation | Judgement |
|---|---|---|
| AHL Reefer Monitored | 285 cubic metres per hour | Accepted: equal to the highest setting |
| AHL Reefer Monitored | 300 cubic metres per hour | Not accepted: above the highest setting |
| AHL Reefer Controlled Atmosphere | 25 cubic metres per hour | Not accepted: ventilation above 0 is not allowed on this tier |
| Any tier | 0 | The ventilation condition applies only to settings above 0, so a setting of 0 does not engage it |

## Points of judgement

**Why can a Superfreezer service not be set at -30.0 °C when a Standard service can?** Each tier has its own range. The Superfreezer range runs from -65.0 °C to -35.0 °C, so -30.0 °C lies outside it even though it is the lowest limit of the Standard and Monitored tiers.

**A Pharma GDP shipper asks for some fresh air.** Fresh-air ventilation is not allowed on AHL Reefer Pharma GDP, so any ventilation setting above 0 is not accepted on that tier.
